nonclaims: Predecessor failures remain failures even when a stabilized simulator scenario later passes.

A deterministic simulator PASS is not a preseal audit, candidate, freeze, launch authority, empirical result, clean matrix, qualification result, production-readiness claim, or release-readiness claim.
This catalog contains no controller implementation.
normalization_rule: One row per distinct controller/process/verifier/custody failure family. Repeated or closely coupled signatures are consolidated and retain every selected evidence reference. A current simulator PASS never changes a predecessor FAIL into a historical PASS. Historical run custody is validated against the recorded commit and bound blobs, not mutable current HEAD equality.
